fix.code:
def label_parcels(names, parcels):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> grams dict and one 'name: grams' line per parcel."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.grams for x in parcels)))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines
